specificFindings: Should not have happened expresses a normative criticism of the preceding violence,not denial that it occurred or endorsement of elite panic. The statement about prolonged trauma and other severe consequences acknowledges harm; it is not an instruction or a claim all survivors have identical outcomes.

Most resilient and most do move on retain majority scope,not universal invulnerability. Emphatic do strengthens an affirmative statement; move on is continuing life rather than necessarily physical relocation or forgetting every loss.

Mastens quoted early image of extraordinary children is the historical idea said to linger. It is not adopted as the requirement for all resilience. Ordinariness/common/basic adaptation supply the contrasting research summary,with appears and most cases preserved.
Other values when happiness feels out of reach allow alternative framing,not a demand to claim immediate happiness or proof that personal treatment outcomes are guaranteed.

GuidoReni is painter,St.Michael is depicted acting onSatans neck,andWilliamJames is the later commentator. So long as is essential to the philosophical condition of restraint; no arbitrary-harm endorsement or empirical universal benefit is added.

Chapter12recaps a tendency for concern for others and new perspective. Tends is not every survivor or proof tragedies should be sought. However introduces peoples self-narratives as a condition in the authors argument,not literal rewriting of past physical events.

Some uplifting versus others dark stories is a contrast of narrative tone,not equal length or a requirement that every story be happy. Quantity and quality are both linked to richness; the more construction expresses a directional claim without inventing an exact numerical coefficient.

The reader-directed life-story question invites reflection rather than collecting a compulsory public biography. Storytelling abilities and structure are distinct questions preparing contrasting narrative examples.

Sound like concerns how a life is presented,not proof additional events happened or a higher measured score was obtained. The G.W.Bushpassage is an example of possible narration,not a newly verified speech or clinical case.

Redirect and story editing are attributed toTimWilson,notAnneWilson,the later study researcher,orJulianBarnes. Highlighting existing challenges is one offered technique,not a requirement to fabricate facts.

Probably and could say preserve the author-proposed Yale framing. Multigenerational describes family connection,not one persons multiple generations. Counterproductive means undermining the stated aim,not endorsement of excessive drinking and partying as productive.

Quite healthy is the authors favourable appraisal,not a universal clinical guarantee or proof every autobiographical memory is historically accurate. The comprehension question deliberately asks about the evaluation visible in its current extract,without requiring an absent antecedent.

The parents might really have been less confident/socially skilled when young. Might and no way to know for sure keep uncertainty,avoiding a claim that all recollection is fabricated. The subsequent longitudinal design aims to compare recollection with actual earlier ratings.

September baseline asks undergraduates about their current independence,confidence,and social skill relative to same-age college peers. It is not retrospective November memory,parents childhood,or comparison with older professors. No later numeric outcome is invented in this question.
